previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: The patient, a woman with type 1 diabetes, depression, and a history of alcohol use, was admitted for diabetic ketoacidosis due to missed insulin doses, presenting with vomiting, hyperglycemia, and fatigue. She was treated in the ICU with an insulin drip, fluid resuscitation, and electrolyte management. Her DKA resolved, renal function normalized, and she was transitioned to subcutaneous insulin. During admission, she developed transient neutropenia, which resolved without infection. She was stabilized on a reduced Lantus dose to prevent hypoglycemia and received support for medication adherence. A visiting nurse and case manager were arranged for home care. She was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up plans for diabetes, mental health, and evaluation of recurrent leukopenia.
